description: This file implements an in-memory mock backend API for storing and retrieving notes, with functionality to push notes to the store and fetch notes updated since a given timestamp.

classes.name: InMemoryNotesApi
classes.description: A mock in-memory implementation of the NotesApi interface, managing a thread-safe store of notes with last-write-wins behavior.

methods.name: pushNotes
methods.description: Stores a list of notes in the in-memory store, updating existing notes if the new note's updatedAt is more recent.

methods.name: fetchNotesUpdatedSince
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes that have been updated after the specified epoch timestamp, sorted by most recent update.
